waypoints.name: Stuart Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From US 2 at the west edge of Leavenworth, turn onto Icicle Road and drive 8.4 miles, then turn left onto FS Road 7601 and follow the rough dirt road 3.7 miles to its end at the Stuart Lake Trailhead, about 3,400 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass and a self-issued Enchantment day-use permit are required.

waypoints.name: Colchuck Lake
waypoints.directions: From the trailhead, follow the Stuart Lake Trail along Mountaineer Creek about 2.5 miles to the signed junction, turn left onto the Colchuck Lake Trail, cross the creek and switchback up to Colchuck Lake at about 5,570 ft.
